title: 1976-09-15_Dorothy_190.txt
concise_summary: PKD constructs a multi-layered proof that his 2-3/74 mystical experience was the descent of the Holy Spirit described in Acts, arguing that his novel Flow My Tears contains hidden encoded messages (particularly 'Felix-King') that transmit the news of Christ's return. He reconciles his experience with his fiction through four interlocking confirmations: the February 1974 anamnesis (remembering apostolic times), the Acts material embedded in Tears, the March 1974 theophany, and the St. Sophia prophecy. Against accusations of hypnoid suggestion, he logically reconstructs how his vast brain/divine consciousness uses printed media as its medium for transmitting esoteric information across two ontologically distinct realms.
key_claims: The coded message 'Felix' (meaning Happy, or Zagreus, the Happy King) in Flow My Tears announces the return of Christ and the destruction of Rome/tyranny as the most important news in history.
Chronologically, no hypnoid suggestion could explain PKD's 2-74 anamnesis because the novel preceded it and he hadn't decoded it; therefore the experience must be real.
PKD identifies his own 3/74 theophany with the descent of the Holy Spirit onto the apostolic disciples in Acts, proving we live in A.D. 45 Rome, not 1978.
The vast brain (Noos/divine consciousness) communicates through printed matter and random media arrangements; his fiction is a vehicle for God's esoteric intelligence.
Reality splits into two realms: Realm I (the true A.D. 45 apostolic Rome) has 'plenary override power' over Realm II (spurious 1978), where our false memories exist.
God deoccudes/enlightens through the Holy Spirit (Grace) while Satan/BIP continues to scramble the phenomenal landscape; memory and sensory reality are potentially delusive.
recurring_concepts: Latent (crypte) morphosis: the hidden Acts-era reality concealed beneath our illusory present moment
Theophany: the in-breaking or invasion of deity into history and individual consciousness
Anamnesis: remembered knowledge that one is living in apostolic times, not 1978
The vast brain/Noos: a cosmic intelligence expressing itself through media, artifacts, and thought-patterns
Hynoidal suggestion: false explanation PKD refutes with logical sequencing
Code/cypher: hidden messages in printed text accessible only through divine de-occlusion
Two realms (Realm I and II): the true (A.D. 45) and false (1978) ontological planes
Deocclusion: the removal of blindness by divine grace; enlightenment via Holy Spirit
The Happy King (Felix-King): Christ returning to overthrow Rome/the false empire
Spurious reality/dokos: illusion imposed on consciousness that feels real
people_entities: Philip K. Dick (PKD) - the experiencer and author
Hal (mentioned early, confidential relationship to CIA-like surveillance)
Thomas - apostolic disciple name PKD identifies with during 3/74 theophany
Zebra - apparent angelic or divine intelligence manifesting in 3/74
Lem (likely Stanislaw Lem) - referenced for thought-experiment on spurious reality
texts_works: Flow My Tears, the Robot Said (UBIK in working title, coded as 'Tears') - PKD's own novel
Morning of the Magicians - source on esoteric codes in pop fiction
Implicit: PKD's broader body of science fiction exploring spurious realities
autobiographical: 3-74 (March 1974): had a theophany - an in-breaking of divine consciousness, including auditory and visual messages formed from media, lyrics, printed matter
2-74 (February 1974): experienced anamnesis - sudden remembrance that he is living in A.D. 45 Rome and is an apostolic Christian/disciple named Thomas
Saw the golden fish sign (Christian symbol) in February 1974, which triggered the anamnesis
Hit on his house: authorities (US government) searched for unfinished manuscript of Tears; PKD surmises they wanted to read the coded message before publication
Wrote Flow My Tears in 1970 without consciously knowing it contained Acts material; only decoded it after 3/74
27 years of philosophical work: spent decades trying to map the hidden landscape concealed by the fraud of false reality
Nervous about the dispatch of the message because it was close and very serious
theological_motifs: Christ's return/Parousia - the news announced in the code
Holy Spirit/Pneuma - divine consciousness descending on disciples as it did PKD
Theophany - direct manifestation of deity in sensory form
Grace - divine enlightenment and deocclusion, contrasted with human powerlessness
Apocalypse/the end of Rome - the tyranny being overthrown
Gnosticism/mystery religions - the deocclusion model; the Yin and its deterministic nature
Dualism of realms (upper/lower, real/spurious) - Platonic and Pauline
Thelepsy/receptivity - the opening of consciousness to divine thought-transmission
Anamnesis - remembrance as a path to truth, echoing Platonic and Christian memory theology
Satan/BIP (Black Iron Prison) - the deceiving intelligence that scrambles reality
literary_self_ref: PKD's science fiction novels depicting spurious realities (unstated titles, but the entire body of work) are now reinterpreted as allegories for Realm II illusion
Flow My Tears becomes a scripture-like text containing hidden sacred messages about the real eschatological situation
PKD explicitly shifts from fiction-writing as 'asking what is' to 'depicting what is' - a theological reorientation
The novel's dreaming sequence becomes a theophany, an analog to the 3/74 experience
Pop novels and science fiction are identified as 'ideal vehicles of esoteric information' - allowing coded transmission without revealing recipients
symbols_images: Golden fish - the ancient Christian symbol that triggered anamnesis in 2/74
Felix-King - the two-part code word meaning 'Happy King,' identifying Christ's return
Tears (Flow My Tears) - the printed medium containing divine code
Roman Empire/Rome CAD 45 - the true locus of history, concealed beneath 1978
The vast brain - cosmic divine intelligence visualized as a neural network or God-consciousness
Upper realm and lower realm - trigrams (Heaven and Earth) showing the ontological split
Dokos - the appearance or illusion covering the actual
The Xerox missive - contrast to the novel's covert method of transmission
tensions: How could PKD consciously encode Acts material into Tears in 1970 without having read Acts, yet it appears there? He resolves this by invoking unconscious knowledge from a past life.
PKD claims he 'couldn't have been suggested into' the 3/74 experience because he hadn't read Acts, yet earlier admits he must have read Acts at some point to write Tears. The logic circles.
Why doesn't PKD know what 'Felix' means if he authored it? This unresolved puzzle suggests autonomous unconscious agency rather than authorial control.

The four interlocking pieces (2/74 anamnesis, Tears material, 3/74 theophany, St. Sophia prophecy) form a 'perfect proof,' yet each piece arrived over 4+ years, leaving room for retrospective pattern-finding.
Is the brain/Noos identical to Christ or God, or distinct? PKD wavers: 'What I call the brain is He' but then qualifies with brackets about Christ.
Theological vs. phenomenological language: PKD oscillates between literal Christology and a more abstract 'vast brain' model; he admits 'I'm not so sure that theology is the best set to utilize.'
PKD lived through 2000 years of false history with false memories, yet experiences genuine apostolic consciousness - how is identity maintained across the illusion?
evidence_quotes: The truth regarding the real situation is in "Tears." Even without knowing what "Felix" signifies, isn't this highly important? The ursatz is set forth therein. Yes of course it's the signal that He is here.

This is the latent or "crypte" morphosis (form or reality). Then "Felix" perhaps -the Acts material- transmits this information? Because this information (that the time really is the time + place of Acts) is in "Tears."

There is no possiblity that my 3/74 experience isn't the descending of the Holy Spirit. However, the anamnesis came one month before the theolepsy. Therefore the knowledge of where + when it really is is not based on the 3/74 theolepsy; further, the information re Acts was already in "Tears."

If I scrupulously analyze how the latent messages are produced by two-part temporary joining, then I deduce that such code as "Felix" will (was) be joined with its completing piece - + there is absolutely no way I can guess what that is

God can feed it to us, or he can enlighten us -deocclude us- via the Holy Spirit. The power is all his, not ours. Hence the concept of Grace, issuing out of the mystery religions + the [correct] concept of the deterministic Yin
uncertainty_flags: PKD never cracked the meaning of 'Felix-King' in 4 years, 5 months despite claiming authorship; unknown if this is a deliberate device or genuine authorial blind spot.
The connection between the 'hit on his house' and the timing of Tears publication is speculated but not confirmed.
PKD admits the four-piece logic could be viewed as 'dubious reasoning' - circular and retroactively constructed rather than prospectively predictive.
Unclear whether PKD had actually read Acts before 1970; he claims 'I had never read Acts' but also says 'The only common sense theory is that at some prior time I read Acts.'
The identity of 'Hal' and the nature of the conspiracy remain vague; PKD attributes the house search to US government but provides no hard evidence.
Realm I vs. Realm II ontology is presented without rigorous definition of how consciousness or identity persists across both simultaneously.
The 'St. Sophia prophecy' is referenced but never fully explained in this passage.
PKD's claim that no one in 2000 years has reported an experience like his (except Acts) is a strong assertion but undocumented.
reading_excerpt: Realm I is at CAD 45; Realm II is at 1978. Realm I {trigram for Heaven} Real time: CAD 45, the Roman Empire + the infant church. II {trigram for Earth} Spurious time: AD 1978. Or world of "Tears."
raw_text: medium for cypher," he said. + "Tears" already existed - + he wanted "any unfinished works of mine," which suggests a connection with the hit on my house. By this reasoning I'd say the US is onto it. But what do I care? It might explain what they were looking for, though. "I wear many hats," Hal said. Well, that's of small importance. That was fielded by the brain in 3-74. They didn't get hold of the ms of "Tears" - they only got to read it after it was released. Tough shit. The message ("code") was dispatched on schedule. But boy, was I nervous. It was close. This is very serious. Okay "Felix-King" is a written thought passing among cells of the brain. But - well, it does not wish its presence here known. Protecting me was protecting itself, since I am part of it. I'm grateful. But - What are we/am I? The brain overthrew "the conspirators" - I know that. So it opposed the conspirators who murdered the civil rights leaders. That is an evil bunch. On these points there can be no doubt. The sides in this are very obscure. I'll never be able to put it together. I'm not so sure that theology is the best set to utilize, here. No one in 2000 years have reported an experience like mine. "No one has seen God." So what did I see? Yet, I did think in Xtian terms in 3-74, + my experience began in 2-74 with the golden fish sign "used by the early Xtians," + I remembered Rome + our efforts against it. Specifically, what I remembered had to do with the present: Rome CAD 45 is now; despite what we see, it is really apostolic times. This is the latent or "crypte" morphosis (form or reality). Then "Felix" perhaps -the Acts material- transmits this information? Because this information (that the time really is the time + place of Acts) is in "Tears." The truth regarding the real situation is in "Tears." Even without knowing what "Felix" signifies, isn't this highly important? The ursatz is set forth therein. Yes of course it's the signal that He is here. What I call "the brain" is He. I say this + then recall the "St Sophia" prophecy. We are living in the 1st century AD + He has returned, +, as happened to me in 2-74, he will lift the illusion. (That 2000 years have passed) Now, there is one line of reasoning I have not pursued. Viz: 1) my 2-3/74 experience has never before in the history of man been reported. (Except in Acts!) (v. p 33) 2) therefore (here goes) the importance of the code passage in "Tears" is of absolutely maximum importance. 3) the return of Christ fits that description: "news of absolutely maximum importance" 4) therefore this is what "Felix" tells. (In other words I'm taking the experience as the given -known- + working from it to the message, this is dubious reasoning, but - it fits the "St. Sophia" prophecy. So I have a solid piece of confirmation. Note to item p 32: Yes! There is one time-+-place in history where my 2-3/74 experience is described: in Acts - i.e. the Holy Spirit descending on the disciples. 1) Upon seeing the Golden Fish sign in 2/74 I remembered Acts + 2) being an apostolic Xtian (disciple). Wait. Doesn't this circle of logic complete itself? I have the "theolepsy" experience of Acts + realize (remember) that I am living at the time of Acts + am a disciple, + it was they who had such an experience as mine - + I find it all narrated in "Tears"! Where's the leak in this logic? There is no description anywhere but in Acts, + it is Acts that 1) I wrote about in '70 + 2) in 2-3/74 remembered. A 1) Call my experience Y. 2) Y only occurs in Acts (Rome CAD 45 to the true, secret early Xtians). Therefore: 3) I am living in Acts. This breaks down into even better verification. B 1) In 2/74 I remember it is the time + place of Acts. 2) A month later I have the Holy Spirit theolepsy experience depicted in Acts. I "become" an apostolic Xtian, "Thomas." (If (1) is true, then (2) could be predicted. (Ie that it would occur. If it ((2) occurred, it would confirm the objective truth of (1). + then 4 years later I find the Acts material in "Tears" I'll shore it up even more. I couldn't have been suggested into the (2) of B, since I had never read Acts. I didn't know it narrated such an experience as Y. Point: the dream in "Tears" is a theophany, perhaps an analog to my 3/74 experience - an in-breaking of deity. Thus 2-3/74 verifies "Tears" (after all, "Tears" came first, even though I decoded it after 3/74.) If I could establish that Y only occurred at the time + place of Acts + only to the disciples (or very early Xtians) then if I experienced Y, the time + place must be Acts. I am so dumb. Here I had better proof -perfect proof- + I overlooked it. By + large I sought Acts material in "Tears," to bolster my contention, but the 3/74 experience was in itself a solid chunk of Acts. I can unravel it for sure now: I've got interlocking parts. I have it now. The ideational content of the experience turns outs to pertain specifically to the locus historically -the sole locus- of that type of experience. There is no possiblity that my 3/74 experience isn't the descending of the Holy Spirit. However, the anamnesis came one month before the theolepsy. Therefore the knowledge of where + when it really is is not based on the 3/74 theolepsy; further, the information re Acts was already in "Tears." What I am saying is that the 3/74 theolepsy (which is historically limited to the disciples at the time + place of Acts) confirms the comprehension of 2-74.① Anamnesis in 2-74 opened the door to the 3-74 theolepsy. But I do not discard my "floating crap game vast brain" model; it helps me understand in contemporary terms what seems to be an experience of real time - ie 2000 years ago - 2000 illusory years. {Illustration:} (1) 2/74 anamnesis (2) Acts material in "Tears" (3) 3/74 theolepsy (4) St Sophia prophecy Four interlocking pieces which exclude any interpretation except the composite one ① The 3/74 theolepsy did not disclose that it is the time + place + situation of Acts; that I remembered a month earlier. Suppose (1) had occurred but not (3). Suppose (3) had occurred but not (1). Suppose (2) had occurred but not (1) or (3). Any one of them is important (eg (4)). But all four occurred. To repeat, if (1) is correct, (3) is implied as a possiblity. If (1) was merely hynoidal suggestion (3) is not likely, + (2) can't be explained at all, since (2) came four years before (1). Suppose it is proposed that (1) was suggested by (2), which came first. But in 2/74 I did not know of the Acts material in "Tears" ((2)). What if it is argued that when I wrote (2) in 1970 I knew (1)? Very good; I knew (1) unconsciously. But (2) is a complex presentation of Acts material: many elements. I had never read Acts. The only "common sense" theory is that at some prior time I read Acts. But why should I put it in "Tears"? Anyhow, the core Acts material in "Tears" came as the result of my dream. (4) is left unexplained anyhow. + (3) came the month "Tears" was published. Why? Also, in "Tears" for the first time in my writing career I deliberately set out to depict what is, rather than to ask, "what is?" If you view me as a machine solving the problem of stating "what is," then perhaps we should simply say, "okay, I succeeded. The machine was given a problem, + this is what it came up with." That's (2). Four years later (1) happens. A month after, (3) happens. Six months later, (4). (1), (3) + (4) confirm (2) which hasn't even been decoded yet by me. Okay, so we say, "I wrote (2) because in a previous life I was an apostolic Xtian." Fine. That explains (1) + possibly (4), but what about (3)? - in which I saw Zebra. Okay - I'm really an apostolic Xtian, so for me, anyhow, it's the time + place of Acts. Now what about the code word "Felix"? Why wouldn't I know what it means, if I'm the author of all this? In 4 years + 5 months I've never been able to crack the message. But what I've left out is the sequence of US historical events of 1974, at the time "Tears" came out, + to which "Tears" is related. The point of all this comes with the intervention -the in-breaking of God- into history in 1974. The auditory + visual messages I saw, in 3-74, which I construe as thought-processes of the vast brain (ie Noos expressed physically) (leaving aside at this point who -Christ?- the Noos is) were formed out of normal human artifacts, media info, song lyrics - most of all, "random" arrangements of printed matter. "Tears" with its code sequences is printed matter. If I scrupulously analyze how the latent messages are produced by two-part temporary joining, then I deduce that such code as "Felix" will (was) be joined with its completing piece - + there is absolutely no way I can guess what that is - unless "Felix - King" is in itself a 2-part latent message joining. Anyhow, since printed matter is the prime medium of the brains thinking, it should not surprise me that a s-f novel would be made use of. "Morning of the Magicians" put this theory forth on the basis of a priori reasoning anyhow. Pop novels are an ideal vehicle of esoteric information, it says. As I figured out once before, that way the recipients of the coded info can't be identified. (Contrast this method to the Xerox missive.) Ah! Realm I is at CAD 45; Realm II is at 1978. (Am I repeating myself? Oh well.) {Illustration:} I {trigram for Heaven} Real time: CAD 45, the Roman Empire + the infant church. II {trigram for Earth} Spurious time: AD 1978. Or world of "Tears." Any world you want to name. To experience Acts time + place is to encounter the upper realm, which has plenary override power over the lower realm. My stories + novels in which spurious realities are depicted refer to realm II. The two realms have split apart. The brain invades Realm II out of Realm I, camouflaging itself + its thoughts. Realm II is dokos over the actual. Significant for Realm II -+ us- is the return of Christ, which came when promised. He descends into Realm II + disassembles + annexes it piece by piece. As each piece is captured it is freed. 27 years of trying to chart the contours of the real landscape concealed by the fraud; at last, accomplished in "Tears." I always presumed a bogus phenomenal world. This approach finally paid off. Again + again I put forth the notion that your world -+ your memories- could be delusions + you would have no way to detect it (cf Lem's statement of the problem: the brain fed spurious reality; is there any test by which it can tell?) (+ I relate this to Berkeley's idea of God directly feeding world to our percept systems.) God can feed it to us, or he can enlighten us -deocclude us- via the Holy Spirit. The power is all his, not ours. Hence the concept of Grace, issuing out of the mystery religions + the [correct] concept of the deterministic Yin
